details.intro:
The Mors Adae (Death of Adam) is an Armenian apocryphon narrating the final hours, death, funeral liturgy, and cosmic burial of Adam by the archangels Michael, Gabriel, Uriel, and Raphael.

It depicts the divine promise of the resurrection at the end of days and the heavenly sealing of Adam's body in the earth until the general resurrection.
details.manuscripts: • Manuscripts: Erevan, Matenadaran MS 711 (17th c.), fol. 389; Matenadaran MS 10200, pp. 402–404 (copied 1624–1666 CE).
